    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBillingAddress" name="Enter billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_Address" name="Address complete"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendShippingAddress" name="Send shipping address" messageRef="Msg_ShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CustomerJoin" name="Payment and address done"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderSubmitted" name="Order data submitted"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Customer" targetRef="Task_LogIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C02" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="SendTask_SendLoginRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C03" sourceRef="SendTask_SendLoginRequest" targetRef="EventGW_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C04" sourceRef="EventGW_LoginResult" targetRef="Catch_LoginSuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C05" sourceRef="EventGW_LoginResult" targetRef="Catch_LoginFailed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C06" sourceRef="Catch_LoginFailed" targetRef="End_ShoppingStopped"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C07" sourceRef="Catch_LoginSuccessful" targetRef="Merge_Products"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C08" sourceRef="Merge_Products" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C09" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C11" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckAllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C12" sourceRef="Task_CheckAllSelected" targetRef="Gateway_AllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllSelectedNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AllSelected" targetRef="Merge_Products"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllSelectedYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AllSelected" targetRef="SendTask_ProductsSelected">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allProductsSelected == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C14" sourceRef="SendTask_ProductsSelected" targetRef="Catch_OrderFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C15" sourceRef="Catch_OrderFinished" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C16" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C17" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C18" sourceRef="Task_EnterPaymentData" targetRef="SendTask_SendPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C19" sourceRef="SendTask_SendPaymentData" targetRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C20" sourceRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmed" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C21" sourceRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_BillingSame"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingSame" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingSame" targetRef="Merge_Address">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${billingAddressEqualsShippingAddress == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingDifferent" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingSame" targetRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C24" sourceRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress" targetRef="Merge_Address"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C25" sourceRef="Merge_Address" targetRef="SendTask_SendShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C26" sourceRef="SendTask_SendShippingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C27" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerJoin" targetRef="End_OrderSubmitted"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EShop" name="E-Shop System" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_LoginRequest" name="Login request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginRequest" messageRef="Msg_LoginRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check login credentials"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CredentialsValid" name="Credentials valid?" default="Flow_CredentialsInvalid"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_LoginSuccessful" name="Send login successful" messageRef="Msg_LoginSuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_LoginFailed" name="Send login failed" messageRef="Msg_LoginFailed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginRejected" name="Login rejected"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ProductsSelected" name="Products selected">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ProductsSelected" messageRef="Msg_ProductsSelected"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepareSplit" name="Prepare payment and shipment"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendPaymentRequest" name="Send payment request" messageRef="Msg_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PaymentConfirmed_Sys" name="Payment confirmation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentConfirmedSys" messageRef="Msg_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ShippingAddress" name="Shipping address received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ShippingAddress" messageRef="Msg_ShippingAddress"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompleteJoin" name="Payment and address complete"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CompleteOrder" name="Complete order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S01" sourceRef="StartEvent_LoginRequest" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S02" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="Gateway_CredentialsValid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CredentialsValid" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CredentialsValid" targetRef="SendTask_LoginSuccessful">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${credentialsValid == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CredentialsInvalid" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CredentialsValid" targetRef="SendTask_LoginFailed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S05" sourceRef="SendTask_LoginFailed" targetRef="End_LoginRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S06" sourceRef="SendTask_LoginSuccessful" targetRef="Catch_ProductsSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S07" sourceRef="Catch_ProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_FinishOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S08" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrder" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S09" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S10" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S11" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="SendTask_SendPaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S12" sourceRef="SendTask_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmed_Sys"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S13" sourceRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmed_Sys" targetRef="Gateway_CompleteJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S14" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Catch_ShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S15" sourceRef="Catch_ShippingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_CompleteJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S16" sourceRef="Gateway_CompleteJoin" targetRef="Task_CompleteOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S17" sourceRef="Task_CompleteOrder" targetRef="End_OrderCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
